deploymentNotes.deployment: To deploy this frontend, follow these steps:
deploymentNotes.step1: 1. Create a .env file with REACT_APP_API_URL and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set to your backend URL
deploymentNotes.step2: 2. Run 'npm run build' to create a production build
deploymentNotes.step3: 3. Deploy the 'build' folder to a static hosting service like Vercel, Netlify, or GitHub Pages
deploymentNotes.step4: 4. Set environment variables in your hosting service dashboard if needed
deploymentNotes.localDevelopment: For local development, run 'npm start' after setting up your .env file
